Upgrades to the biological treatment process to enhance total inorganic nitrogen removal. The project would remove the fixed film reactors from the treatment train and add nitrogen removal and membrane aerated biofilm reactor process units to the existing aeration basins to improve and intensify the treatment process.

A Horizontal Levee Pilot Project would consist of constructing a berm and horizontal levee along a portion of existing upland habitat adjacent to Harbor Marsh. The horizontal levee would be planted with various native plants to restore diverse transitional habitats, including freshwater marsh, wet meadow, and riparian scrub, and would provide wave attenuation, sea level rise adaptation space, and refugia habitat for key species, such as the salt marsh harvest mouse.
